captions.detailed: A wall-mounted ventilation fan featuring a cylindrical main drum housing attached to a square rear frame. The front of the assembly includes a louvered cover that hinges downward from its top edge. Inside the drum, a multi-bladed dark fan rotates continuously, while a small black speed knob is positioned on the lower corner of the frame to control operation.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a through-wall ventilation fan with a round drum housing, an internal fan blade, a front louvered cover, and a speed control knob. The louvered cover must drop open via a revolute hinge at its top edge, the fan blade should rotate continuously, and the speed knob on the inner frame must rotate continuously.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing by combining a hollowed-out cylinder (drum) with a thin square backplate. Create the interior fan assembly using a central cylinder hub and radial rectangular blades, and model the speed knob as a small knurled or simple cylinder. Define the louvered cover as a flat plate with angled ventilation slats, and establish three articulations: a continuous joint for the fan blade rotation, a continuous joint for the speed knob, and a revolute joint along the top edge of the cover to allow it to swing open.
